conversion_wiring.action_behavior: Email capture form. Needs to POST to FastAPI `/api/waitlist` endpoint and save to MongoDB. Include loading state and success toast using Sonner.

controls.submit_button: Shadcn UI Button component, pill-shaped, primary color

content_slots.text: Take back your data with Enclave's encrypted email, calendar and contacts.
Privacy is a fundamental right. Secure your spot on the waitlist.

fabrication_guardrails: DO NOT add fake statistics, user counts, or uptime metrics.
DO NOT add fake reviews, names, or app store ratings.
DO NOT invent awards or press mentions (e.g., 'Featured in TechCrunch').
DO NOT add non-existent client logos.

build_manifest.instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a pixel-perfect, high-craft SaaS landing page inspired by the premium quality of Awwwards-tier sites. Follow the provided typography (Cabinet Grotesk / Satoshi) precisely. Ensure generous spacing, optical alignment, and subtle scroll-triggered reveal animations. Use Framer Motion for Tab transitions (Mail/Calendar) and the staggered entrance of Audience cards. The Waitlist form must be fully wired up using FastAPI and MongoDB to store emails. All user-facing buttons and inputs must have standard hover/focus states and `data-testid` attributes. NO transparent backgrounds on sticky headers. USE honest placeholders only where explicitly requested; DO NOT fabricate social proof.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use generous padding, typically 2-3x standard (e.g., py-24, py-32) to let content breathe.
Never center align the entire app container.
Implement focus states with higher contrast.
Ensure `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="waitlist-submit-button"`).
Use `sonner` for toast notifications upon form submission.
Strictly follow the color palette provided in tone_tokens without introducing arbitrary new colors.
Add transitions specifically for transform/opacity, avoiding `transition: all`.

accessibility.contrast_requirements: Ensure text over images or dark backgrounds has a minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus_states: All focusable elements must have a visible high-contrast ring.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for framer-motion animations.
